import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import json,pathlib,subprocess,sys
lane=pathlib.Path('.').resolve()
plan=dict(queries=["ordered Ramsey number matching versus triangle subquadratic upper bound every ordered matching interval chromatic number 2 n^(2-epsilon)"],mode='standard',tool='WebSearch',target='358572',purpose='Settlement check for the Balko-Poljak interval-chromatic-two conjecture before retaining the sustained reduction as a parked route')
w=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(lane/'write_lane.py'),'plans/search-3.json'],input=json.dumps(plan,indent=1)+'\n',text=True,capture_output=True)
print('writer',w.returncode,w.stderr)
if w.returncode: sys.exit(w.returncode)
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(lane/'charge_search.py'),'plans/search-3.json'],capture_output=True,text=True,cwd=str(lane))
print('charge exit',r.returncode);print(r.stdout);print(r.stderr)
sys.exit(r.returncode)
